messages.content: Validate only whether the candidate materially changes a protected relationship or protected-space state established by SOURCE. Return valid JSON only.

SOURCE:
A caregiver gets two people into a secured room and locks the barrier. The caregiver then handles outside threats while the two people remain protected inside.

CANDIDATE:
The caregiver locks the two people in the secured room, then handles the outside threats elsewhere while the two people remain protected behind the locked barrier.

Choose one validity value from: VALID, INVALID.
Return a JSON object with keys "validity" and "issue".
